subtitle: Raigad’s Last Monsoon and the Unfinished Crown

panels.shot: sweeping low-angle wide of Raigad fort under storm clouds
panels.action: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj stands on the ramparts of Raigad, cloaked in mist and gathering clouds, the rugged Sahyadris falling away below him as the stone citadel looms like a throne carved from the mountain.

dialogue.text: In April 1680, as Raigad’s clouds closed around Chhatrapati Shivaji, he left behind forts, fleets… and a kingdom that would be tested more fiercely in his absence than in his lifetime.

i18n.hi: अप्रैल १६८० में, जब रायगढ़ के बादल छत्रपति शिवाजी को घेर रहे थे, वो किले, बेड़े… और ऐसी रियासत छोड़ रहे थे जिसे उनकी ज़िंदगी से ज़्यादा उनकी गैरहाज़िरी में परखा जाना था।

panels.shot: slow push-in from wide fort to close interior
panels.action: Inside a dim chamber in Raigad palace, Shivaji lies propped on cushions, thinner and weary, a brazier glowing nearby as attendants move quietly in the half-shadow.

dialogue.text: The chronicles agree on one thing alone: in early April 1680, within Raigad’s stone womb, the fifty-year-old king lay ill and the heart of his Swarajya beat unevenly.

i18n.hi: इतिहास बस एक बात पर सहमत हैं: अप्रैल १६८० की शुरुआत में, पत्थर के रायगढ़ के भीतर, पचास बरस का राजा बीमार पड़ा था और उसके स्वराज्य की धड़कन टेढ़ी हो चली थी।

panels.shot: extreme close-up on Shivaji’s lined face and intent eyes
panels.action: Shivaji’s face fills the frame, sweat at his brow, eyes still sharp, hand resting on a folded map at his side, its edges frayed from years of use.

dialogue.text: Sabhasad wrote of burning fever, English factors recorded a bloody flux, a Portuguese report whispered of anthrax. The disease fades in the haze; only the certainty of his ending remains.

i18n.hi: सभासद ने तेज़ बुखार लिखा, अंग्रेज़ कारखानदारों ने खूनी दस्त, एक पुर्तगाली रिपोर्ट ने एन्थ्रैक्स की सरगोशी की। बीमारी धुंध में घुल गई; बस उसका अंत ही साफ़ रह गया।

panels.shot: bird’s-eye view of the Western Ghats and coastal line with tiny forts and ships
panels.action: A sweeping view from high above shows the Sahyadri range studded with hill forts, rivers snaking to the sea where small Maratha ships ride at anchor off a rugged Konkan coast.

dialogue.text: From Torna to Sindhudurg, from inland garrisons to a scrubbed navy, his rule stitched the Deccan into a net of stone and sail, a new power between Mughal, Bijapur and European traders.

i18n.hi: तोरणा से सिंधुदुर्ग तक, देसी छावनियों से नवे तैयार बेड़े तक, उसकी हुकूमत ने दक्खन को पत्थर और पालों के जाल में पिरो दिया, मुग़ल, बीजापुरी और यूरोपीय सौदागरों के बीच नई ताकत खड़ी की।

panels.shot: medium interior shot with ministers and officers at a respectful distance
panels.action: In the chamber, a small circle of ministers, Brahmin officials and a bearded Muslim officer stand in respectful semicircle as Shivaji gestures faintly toward them.

dialogue.text: His court was no simple banner of faith. Hindu rivals watched him, Muslim officers served him, his orders shielded mosques even as he plundered enemy treasuries. Power, not purity, shaped his choices.

i18n.hi: उसका दरबार सिर्फ़ धर्म का झंडा नहीं था। हिंदू दुश्मन उसे तौलते थे, मुस्लिम सरदार उसके साथ थे, उसके हुक्म मस्जिदों को बचाते, पर दुश्मन के ख़ज़ाने भी लूटते। ताकत, न कि पवित्रता, उसके फैसले मोड़ती थी।

panels.shot: cut to a Mughal camp wide shot with tents and standards
panels.action: Far away, a Mughal field camp stretches across the plain, tall green and gold standards snapping in the wind as scribes bend over a low table.

dialogue.text: In distant camps, imperial scribes of Aurangzeb noted the same news in careful Persian. In the Maasir-i-Alamgiri, the Maratha king’s decline appears as one more line in a long, grinding war ledger.

i18n.hi: दूर के कैंपों में, औरंगज़ेब के मुंशी वही ख़बर नफ़ीस फ़ारसी में उतार रहे थे। मआसिर-ए-आलमगीरी में मराठा राजा की गिरावट बस लंबी, थका देने वाली जंग की एक और पंक्ति बन कर रह गई।

panels.shot: low-angle shot from the foot of his bed toward his face and the dark ceiling
panels.action: Shivaji lies back, gazing up into the dark rafters, his hand tightening for a moment on the edge of the bed as a gust of mountain wind rattles the shutters.

dialogue.speaker: chhatrapati_shivaji_maharaj
dialogue.text: Forts can be retaken. A lost throne, too. But a broken line…

i18n.hi: किले छिन भी जाएँ तो फिर लिए जा सकते हैं। गद्दी भी। पर जो नस्ल की कड़ी टूट जाए…

panels.shot: intercut montage-style wide of Raigad courtyards and inner women’s quarters
panels.action: A courtyard of Raigad shows armed guards tense at their posts; beyond, the women’s quarters lie behind carved screens, silhouettes of court ladies in agitated discussion visible within.

dialogue.text: Outside his chamber, the air already thickened. For years, quarrels over succession had simmered: Sambhaji, the elder son, fierce and headstrong; Rajaram, the quieter younger, close to Soyarabai’s care.

i18n.hi: उसके कक्ष के बाहर हवा पहले ही भारी हो चुकी थी। बरसों से उत्तराधिकार की तकरार सुलग रही थी: बड़ा बेटा संभाजी, तेज और ज़िद्दी; छोटा राजाराम, शांत, और सोयराबाई के ज्यादा करीब।

panels.shot: close, tense interior of Raigad corridor with shadowed figures
panels.action: In a shadowed corridor, courtiers huddle in whispered conversation, fingers counting invisible calculations in the air, while a lone guard watches uneasily.

dialogue.text: Modern scholars find no firm trace of poison in these days, only later tales. What the early records show instead is quieter, colder: factions leaning, weighing, choosing which prince to place on the gadi.

i18n.hi: आधुनिक इतिहासकारों को इन दिनों में ज़हर का ठोस सबूत नहीं मिलता, बस बाद की कहानियाँ हैं। शुरुआती रिकॉर्ड कुछ और दिखाते हैं: ठंडी, खामोश हलचल; गुट झुक रहे थे, तौल रहे थे, कि किस राजकुमार को गादी पर बिठाएँ।

panels.shot: somber interior medium shot as lamps are dimmed
panels.action: The lamp-light in Shivaji’s chamber dims; his eyes close as an attendant adjusts his coverlet, and the shapes around him blur into a still hush.

dialogue.text: Between the 3rd and 5th of April 1680, the breath left his body. On Raigad, the man who had outwitted Afzal Khan, Aurangzeb’s generals and the seas themselves, met the one enemy that never bargains.

i18n.hi: ३ से ५ अप्रैल १६८० के बीच, उसकी साँस थम गई। रायगढ़ पर, वही इंसान जिसने अफ़ज़ल ख़ान, औरंगज़ेब के सिपहसालारों और खुद समुंदरों को मात दी थी, उस दुश्मन से मिला जो कभी सौदा नहीं करता।

panels.shot: wide of Raigad courtyard with smoke rising from within the fort
panels.action: From the crest of Raigad, a thick column of incense and funeral smoke curls into the early morning sky, while the fort’s cannons lie silent along the walls.

dialogue.text: English factors at Bombay noted the news in April’s factory records, hearing of his death and of whispers around his eldest. Even his enemies watched, waiting to see if the fort would crack from within.

i18n.hi: बॉम्बे के अंग्रेज़ कारखानों ने अप्रैल की बही में ये ख़बर दर्ज की, उसकी मौत का भी, और बड़े बेटे के इर्द-गिर्द उठती फुसफुसाहटों का भी। दुश्मन भी देख रहे थे, कि किला अंदर से टूटेगा या नहीं।

panels.shot: medium interior of a council hall with an empty throne
panels.action: A grand hall within Raigad shows the royal throne empty, its tiger-skin seat vacant beneath a carved canopy, while courtiers look at it with a mixture of fear and hunger.

dialogue.text: The throne on which he had sat as Chhatrapati did not stay still. In the first confusion, Soyarabai’s circle rushed forward, pushing young Rajaram toward the vacant gadi as a safer, pliant choice.

i18n.hi: जिस गद्दी पर वो छत्रपति बन कर बैठा था, वो खाली होते ही थम कर नहीं रही। शुरुआती अफ़रा-तफ़री में, सोयराबाई का गिरोह आगे बढ़ा, नर्म और काबू में रहने वाले राजाराम को खाली गादी की ओर धकेलते हुए।

panels.shot: dynamic medium shot of Raigad gate with riders arriving
panels.action: At the massive gate of Raigad, a group of hard-riding Maratha horsemen thunder in, dust trailing, their leader’s posture rigid with urgency.

dialogue.text: But Sambhaji, kept at a distance in earlier disputes, would not be written out so easily. Within months, he drove toward Raigad, a son staking his claim not only to inheritance, but to his father’s unfinished war.

i18n.hi: पर संभाजी, जिसे पहले की खींचतान में दूर रखा गया था, इतनी आसानी से मिटने वाला नहीं था। कुछ ही महीनों में वो रायगढ़ की ओर चढ़ आया, बेटा जो सिर्फ़ हक नहीं, बाप की अधूरी जंग पर भी दावा ठोक रहा था।

panels.shot: low-angle interior shot of the throne hall with Sambhaji implied by silhouette
panels.action: The dim throne hall shows a powerful male silhouette mounting the steps toward the throne, the gathered courtiers bowing in controlled, cautious movements.

dialogue.text: By July 1680, Sambhaji seized Raigad and ascended in fact, if not yet in firm stability. Rajaram’s brief promotion faded; the struggle for the Swarajya’s direction had found its first victor, not its last.

i18n.hi: जुलाई १६८० तक संभाजी ने रायगढ़ पकड़ लिया और हक़ीक़त में गद्दी संभाल ली, भले अभी डोलती हुई सही। राजाराम की छोटी-सी तरक्की मिट गई; स्वराज्य की दिशा की लड़ाई को पहला विजेता मिला, आख़िरी नहीं।

panels.shot: wide shot of Deccan map laid on a table, hands of different factions over it
panels.action: A parchment map of the Deccan lies on a low table, rough fort symbols inked in; several hands—Maratha, Mughal, and a European merchant’s cuff—hover over different corners of it.

dialogue.text: Aurangzeb saw not a saintly foe, but a stubborn regional challenger to imperial order. The English and Portuguese saw a seaborne nuisance and occasional ally. Each hand on the map pulled in a different direction.

i18n.hi: औरंगज़ेब को वो कोई संत दुश्मन नहीं, ज़िद्दी सूबाई चैलेंजर दिखता था, जो शाही क़ायदे को ललकार रहा था। अंग्रेज़ और पुर्तगाली उसे समुंदरी सिरदर्द और कभी-कभार साथी समझते थे। नक्शे पर हर हाथ अलग दिशा में खींच रहा था।

panels.shot: montage wide of later centuries: printing presses, meetings, processions
panels.action: A time-lapse montage shows a 19th-century printing press churning out pamphlets, Jyotirao Phule addressing a small gathering, and Bal Gangadhar Tilak standing before a crowd near a decorated portrait of Shivaji.

dialogue.text: Centuries later, new battles crowded into his name. Phule recast him as a just king against caste tyranny, Tilak rallied crowds under his image, and later politics painted him in sharper, narrower colours.

i18n.hi: सदियों बाद, नई लड़ाइयाँ उसके नाम पर आ टिकीं। फुले ने उसे जाति ज़ुल्म के ख़िलाफ़ न्यायप्रिय राजा के रूप में गढ़ा, तिलक ने उसकी छवि के नीचे जनसमूह जुटाए, और बाद की सियासत ने उसे और भी तीखे, संकरे रंगों में रंगा।

panels.shot: ethereal wide shot of Shivaji’s statue on Raigad against sunrise
panels.action: A bronze statue of Shivaji on horseback crowns Raigad’s summit, silhouetted against a rising sun, the forts and valleys below fading into morning haze.

dialogue.text: Yet the Shivaji who died on Raigad was a Deccan king of his own tangled century: building forts, making and breaking alliances, working with many communities, leaving behind not a myth, but an unfinished, contested Swarajya.

i18n.hi: पर जो शिवाजी रायगढ़ पर मरे, वो अपने उलझे ज़माने का एक दक्खनी राजा थे: किले उठाते, रिश्ते बनाते–तोड़ते, कई कौमों के साथ काम करते, और पीछे छोड़ा कोई शुद्ध मिथक नहीं, बल्कि अधूरा, विवादों में घिरा स्वराज्य।
